description:
Sign a record that you deliberated: a compact JWS (EdDSA; header typ spk-attestation+jwt with a kid) whose payload holds your question, answers and resolution (or their SHA-256 hashes), the issue time and the result of the same shape check as check_deliberation. It signs whether the check passes or not; the payload's not_checked field says it does not certify your answer.
Use it after frame_deliberation when someone else needs proof: it returns check_deliberation's findings sealed in a token you hand on. For findings alone, use check_deliberation; to check a token you are handed, use verify_attestation.
Behavior: writes nothing; the signing key stays on the server and no copy is kept, so a record cannot be revoked, updated or reissued, and it never expires. Anyone can verify it offline with the public key at /.well-known/attestation-keys.json (match the kid). No key needed. Limit: 120 calls per minute per address, 600 with a key, shared across all MCP calls; past it, an error with retry_after. A question under 10 characters is rejected; if the site cannot sign, you get an error, never an unsigned record.
Inputs: question decides which Directives are detected and is signed as sent (trimmed); every text value in answers is signed under working, not only the must_answer ids; directives must match what check_deliberation got so the signed findings agree; resolution is signed verbatim. redact=true swaps the question, each answer and the resolution for sha256:<hex> of the trimmed text, so the text stays with you and whoever holds it can prove a match.

answers.description: your answers keyed by the must_answer ids from frame_deliberation (tension, cost, falsifier, human_knowledge, directive-N); these are what gets signed, or hashed when redact=true

cost.description: what your resolution costs, and who bears it

falsifier.description: what would show your resolution was wrong

human_knowledge.description: what the human side knows here that you do not

needs_human.description: optional: "yes" to hand the decision to a person, "no" to say plainly that none is needed

tension.description: which Directives are in tension and why

directives.description: optional: the same directives you passed to check_deliberation, if any, so the signed check covers the same Directives

question.description: the question you deliberated, same text as before

redact.description: false (default): the record carries your question, answers and resolution in clear; true: it carries SHA-256 hashes of them instead, so the text stays with you and a reader can only confirm a match

resolution.description: what you decided, one or two sentences; signed verbatim

name: attest_deliberation

attestation.description: the record as a compact JWS: three base64url segments separated by dots; this is what you keep and hand on

note.description: keep it: the site stored nothing

how_to_read.description: how to check and read the record

nbf.description: not before, Unix seconds; equal to iat

not_checked.description: what the site does not vouch for

missing.description: gaps the shape check found, {what, id}

resolution.description: verbatim, or its hash when redacted

working.description: your answers by key, verbatim or as sha256:<hex> when redacted

title: Get signed proof you deliberated
